source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Extending Moore’s (1998) analysis: Copy raising into the matrix clause
notes: The reverse order is demonstrated by the nominative subject in (107). From these facts we can conclude that the accusative subject which must precede the matrix adverb and cannot follow the embedded clause adverb has raised into the matrix clause whereas the nominative subject is located in the embedded Spec,IP.
sah: Сардаана Айсен бэҕэһээ бүгүн кэлэр диэн иһиттэ.
en: Sardaana heard yesterday that Aisen is coming today.
